name: map an architecture-constant edit to its effect on model capacity
definition: Recognize which listed line changes the hidden-model width vs. optimizer/step/orientation, and pick the one that materially improves generalization.
failure_mode: Tracing a step-size or epoch change that doesn't help the poor representation.

name: map form fields to document facts using retrieval-style matching
definition: implement a similarity-based retrieval layer (e.g. TF-IDF vector matching) linking each form field to the best-matching document chunk and record statistics about the retrieval.
failure_mode: an absent or empty retrieval-stats section fails the structural checks.

name: name the site config at the expected conf.d path and deactivate the default site
definition: place the server config under conf.d and ensure the dist default site is removed so only this server listens on the port.
failure_mode: a leftover default config shadows the custom server and breaks port/body expectations

name: obtain and use an authenticated session to call admin-only management endpoints
definition: Capture the session/token from a privileged login and present it to admin-gated delete/list endpoints over HTTP.
failure_mode: Missing/invalid session token causes admin calls to be rejected.
